creator: Alexander Terp
description: From 2026-10-24 (84f9d3e8's review). An agent that leaves every group while a fold to an unreachable home is still owed drops its participant and its owed fold, so the home keeps listing the pane in that group. Predates the owed-fold work. A fix would have leave send a Leave for the pane to that home. Also narrow: refold reads the owed list before a whole leave runs and sends after it, so the home can list the name while nobody here holds it.
title: Leaving every group while a fold is owed leaves the pane listed at the home
